llm_response.reason: The website exhibits multiple scam indicators: (1) extremely low prices on high-value products (e.g., laptops under $600, smartwatches for $63, name-brand headphones for $167), (2) an improbable mixture of unrelated high-demand items with fake-sounding sales numbers, (3) absence of working navigation links, terms, or detailed company/contact information, (4) site domain registered only days ago using full privacy obfuscation and a suspicious .cc TLD, and (5) psychological manipulation via urgent phrases and impossible deals. All of these are classic signs of a fake online shopping scam.
